description: Name the song playing near the robot only when asked what it is, never to play, add or change music.

offer.reason: Off until the song-name bench row has a passed run (rule 1). Then back to conditional with gate songNameAllowed.

author: MaiPai

examples: could you tell me what's playing

action.description: listen names the song playing now and is only for a question about what is playing or who sings it, never for volume, playlists or playing music. After a song was already named: reject when the person says that is wrong, suggest when they propose a title (also set title), confirm when they say it is right.

title.description: The song title the person suggests.
